workflow.action: Rack or wire the piece once for the whole chain
workflow.description: Set firm hidden contacts and a drain-and-vent orientation so no later step needs a re-grip
workflow.artifact: racked load ready for wet work
workflow.gate: contact firmness and drainage orientation verified before the first tank

workflow.action: Soak degrease per the cleaner's TDS
workflow.description: Heated alkaline soak removes buffing compound and oils; time, temperature, and strength per the sheet and the log
workflow.artifact: bulk-degreased load with a soak log entry
workflow.gate: no visible compound in recesses under a loupe before the load moves on

workflow.description: Cavitation in warm alkaline cleaner clears links, filigree, and hollows; rotate the load for coverage
workflow.gate: the worst recess on the load inspects clean; any construction doubt stops the cycle and returns the piece

workflow.action: Electroclean in the polarity the substrate class dictates
workflow.description: Gas-scrub the final soil monolayer - anodic for steel, time-limited or sheet-sanctioned regimes for tarnish-prone alloys
workflow.gate: lead polarity checked against the docket class before current is applied

workflow.action: Run the water-break test and record the read
workflow.description: Withdraw from clean rinse water and read the film over every face after honest rinsing
workflow.artifact: recorded gate pass for this cleaning cycle
workflow.gate: unbroken sheeting passes; any beading loops the load back to soak, never forward

workflow.action: Select the activation branch from the verified substrate class
workflow.description: Key the branch - mild dip, pickle path, die-cast caution, or passive handoff - strictly from the docket class
workflow.artifact: branch selection noted on the job
workflow.gate: ambiguous class refuses back to assessment; no activation by appearance

workflow.action: Pickle oxide-bearing work on the branches that sanction it
workflow.description: Shortest exposure producing a uniform active surface, inhibited per TDS, lids and fume path per layout
workflow.artifact: oxide-free active surface with logged exposure
workflow.gate: uniform matte surface with detail intact; pitting or smut halts the branch for review

workflow.action: Final activation dip immediately before transfer
workflow.description: Seconds-long dip resets flash oxide from rinsing; from this moment the piece is on the clock
workflow.artifact: activated piece with the transfer clock running
workflow.gate: the dip is the last chemistry before the tank and is never used as a holding bath

workflow.action: Confirm final rinse water against its setpoint
workflow.description: Conductivity-pen reading of the final rinse on cadence, DI grade verified for make-up and last stages
workflow.artifact: dated conductivity reading in the log
workflow.gate: reading at or below the logged setpoint; a failed reading blocks release until the water grade is restored

workflow.action: Transfer wet and fast inside the clock
workflow.description: Rack-and-tool movement over the shortest path, piece never drying, batch sized to the window
workflow.artifact: piece at the tank inside its window
workflow.gate: any bloom, dry-out, or delay loops the piece back through activation instead of proceeding

workflow.action: Release to the tank with a recorded plate-ready line
workflow.description: One log line ties piece, docket, gate pass, branch, clock, and rinse reading together at the moment of entry
workflow.artifact: release record the downstream bench can trust
workflow.gate: all five release conditions evidenced contemporaneously; anything missing loops to the owning node

priority_rationale: The frame and safety nodes come first because everything on the line presupposes them: the soil-class ladder orders the stations, the intake docket decides what may enter, the TDS discipline governs every tank, and cyanide/acid segregation overrides all of it wherever both chemistries exist; the cleaning chain then runs in its anti-rework order - bulk soak before cavitation before electroclean - into the water-break gate, because activation may only ever touch verified-clean metal; the activation family branches off the verified substrate class next, since a wrong branch is the line's most destructive error; rinse design, water quality, drag control, and handling protect what the chain has bought; and the transfer clock, release definition, and failure diagnosis close the loop because they convert prep from effort into evidence the downstream benches can trust.

dominance_rules.rule: Cyanide/acid segregation dominates every process, layout, and schedule choice
dominance_rules.rationale: acid on cyanide liberates fatal hydrogen cyanide gas; no throughput or convenience argument sits in the same category
dominance_rules.trigger: any new product, layout change, drain question, or storage decision where the two chemistries could meet
dominance_rules.action: halt the change until segregation is demonstrated physically - or delete the hazard by choosing cyanide-free products

dominance_rules.rationale: a flagged or undocumented customer piece destroyed in chemistry cannot be bought back; a refused job can be renegotiated
dominance_rules.trigger: a piece arrives without a docket, with a stale docket, or with a flag the wet line cannot honor
dominance_rules.action: refuse the piece back to assessment regardless of schedule, and never resolve the doubt by the plater's own test at the wet bench

dominance_rules.rationale: activating or plating over organics converts minutes of loop-back into hours of strip-and-replate
dominance_rules.trigger: any beading or marginal read at the gate, especially under schedule pressure
dominance_rules.action: fail the piece backward to soak; adjust batch size or promises, never the reading

dominance_rules.rationale: chemistry ceilings protect what cannot be rebuilt - die-cast detail, solder seams, buffed finishes
dominance_rules.trigger: soil persists at the substrate's chemistry ceiling and escalation would exceed the branch
dominance_rules.action: return the piece to assessment for refuse-or-refer instead of exceeding the ceiling

dominance_rules.rationale: the sheet is the only written referee for a commercial product's window, and habit is how a previous product's rules outlive it
dominance_rules.trigger: memory and sheet disagree, or a mixing or regeneration idea is not on the sheet
dominance_rules.action: run per the sheet; where the sheet is silent, query the supplier before the tank sees an experiment

dominance_rules.rationale: a blown transfer clock hides an oxide film under the deposit; the loop is minutes, the failure is a full rework and a customer conversation
dominance_rules.trigger: delay, dry-out, or visible bloom between activation and tank entry
dominance_rules.action: loop the piece back through activation and restart the clock, whatever the schedule cost

dominance_rules.rationale: the conductivity setpoint protects nickel and gold chemistry from chloride and hardness; savings belong in the early stages
dominance_rules.trigger: a proposal to cut stages, extend DI cartridge life, or top up final rinses from the tap
dominance_rules.action: hold the setpoint at the critical end and take every water saving in the tap-grade dilution stages

dominance_rules.rule: Documented sign-off dominates assumption for anything irreversible
dominance_rules.rationale: the irreversibility doctrine of the intake docket extends to the wet line: a step that could permanently alter a customer piece needs the customer's recorded consent, obtained upstream
dominance_rules.trigger: a prep action on customer work that could etch, dull, open, or alter the piece beyond restoration
dominance_rules.action: verify the docket's sign-off covers the action; absent that coverage, the piece returns to assessment for the conversation

dominance_rules.rationale: prep faults cause most plating failures and cost nothing to inspect; bath dumping is expensive and usually exonerates the true fault
dominance_rules.trigger: any adhesion or appearance failure on plated work
dominance_rules.action: run the signature ladder across the prep chain and clear it before any bath chemistry is touched

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify the substrate class from the docket before choosing any activation chemistry
anti_rework_rules.prevents: wrong-branch acid destroying die-cast or copper-alloy work and the total-loss rework that follows

anti_rework_rules.rule: Degrease fully before any acid step
anti_rework_rules.prevents: acid pitting the metal under oil it cannot remove, which no later step can level

anti_rework_rules.rule: Pass the water-break gate before activation or pickle
anti_rework_rules.prevents: locking organic soil under an activated surface and paying for it as strip-and-replate

anti_rework_rules.rule: Design the rinse cascade and dead-rinse placement before the first production load
anti_rework_rules.prevents: drag-in poisoning downstream chemistry in week one and the bath replacement that follows

anti_rework_rules.rule: Time the dip-to-tank path and set batch size before activating anything
anti_rework_rules.prevents: end-of-batch pieces blowing the transfer window by design and looping through activation every cycle

anti_rework_rules.rule: Rack once, correctly, before the soak
anti_rework_rules.prevents: mid-chain re-grips that are handling events, each of which restarts the chain at soak

anti_rework_rules.rule: Start the bench log - loads, additions, control tests - on day one of every tank
anti_rework_rules.prevents: solution exhaustion surfacing as a failed customer batch instead of a scheduled quiet-morning remake

anti_rework_rules.rule: Check drain dwell and rack rinsing before blaming any downstream bath
anti_rework_rules.prevents: dumping healthy chemistry while the open drag route re-poisons its replacement

anti_rework_rules.rule: Stage clean tools and confirm no-touch reach at every station before the chain starts
anti_rework_rules.prevents: the improvised finger rescue mid-transfer and the from-soak restart it forces

iteration_protocol.trigger: water-break failure rate rises across a shift or week
iteration_protocol.action: run the cleaner and electrocleaner control tests against the log, check polarity settings, and remake per TDS before re-running failed work from soak

iteration_protocol.trigger: an adhesion failure appears on released work
iteration_protocol.action: run the signature ladder, correct the implicated prep node, audit the release line that passed the piece, and only then consider bath causes

iteration_protocol.trigger: a new substrate class or a new supplier product arrives
iteration_protocol.action: file the TDS/SDS, transcribe setpoints, rule its polarity and activation branch, and update the map before the first production piece

iteration_protocol.trigger: flash rust, dry-out, or repassivation is observed at tank entry
iteration_protocol.action: re-time the dip-to-tank path, cut batch size to the window, and move stations closer if the walk is the cause

iteration_protocol.trigger: final-rinse conductivity creeps upward at constant duty
iteration_protocol.action: service or replace the DI source, verify no tap top-ups, review drag-out drain dwell, and consider an added cascade stage

iteration_protocol.trigger: any tank, product, or bench-position change on the line
iteration_protocol.action: walk the layout for segregation, drains, labels, containment, and extraction before the changed line runs its first piece

iteration_protocol.trigger: repeat gate failures cluster on one geometry class - hollows, chains, deep filigree
iteration_protocol.action: revisit racking orientation and ultrasonic coverage for that class, and if its construction is the problem, send the class question back to assessment
